name: Yahagi Yajuurou
source:
A buddy assigned to Tsubaki from the neighboring district. A third-year student at the academy.
He’s a so-called delinquent known for his rough language and behavior.
He ends up forming a temporary partnership with the main heroine, Haruka, and they end up having a physical relationship.
